patch_description: Restructure the solver as a three-stage pipeline: (1) a feasibility/lower-bound stage that computes an analytic lower bound on the optimal KVPR (max single-model pressure) plus an upper bound from a memory-aware greedy packing; (2) a warm-started binary search on the target KVPR λ, where each candidate λ is tested with several λ-constrained greedy orderings (each model goes to the GPU with best resulting pressure among GPUs that keep pressure ≤ λ); (3) a move+swap local search that polishes the best packing found. The binary search brackets the optimum tightly from warm-started bounds (instead of [0, 1e9]), and every feasible λ-packing is scored and kept if it improves the best-so-far, so the local search starts from a near-optimal solution rather than a plain greedy one.
